name: webchat
description: Serverless real-time chat on AWS. React frontend on CloudFront, WebSocket Lambdas behind API Gateway, DynamoDB for connections + nick assignment.

scripts.deploy: bun run deploy:backend && bun run deploy:frontend
scripts.deploy:backend: cd infrastructure/cdk && bunx cdk deploy WebChatStack --require-approval never --outputs-file cdk-outputs.json
scripts.deploy:frontend: cd frontend && bun run build && aws s3 sync dist s3://$(jq -r '.WebChatStack.FrontendBucketName' ../infrastructure/cdk/cdk-outputs.json) --delete && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id $(jq -r '.WebChatStack.FrontendDistributionId' ../infrastructure/cdk/cdk-outputs.json) --paths '/*'
